# Same Old Samsara

> The creative outlet of Chad and Daniel: a documentary series about building a homestead on 34 acres in Central New York, handmade beaded jewelry (Etsy: sameoldsamsara), and free brick stitch and bead loom beading patterns. Motto: the same old cycle.

Headings on this site are lowercase on purpose. Prices are in USD.

## Films
- [Films](https://sameoldsamsara.xyz/films/): A documentary about our first year out here. Episode 1 starts at the very beginning, when we first stepped onto the land. New episodes through the winter. Season 2 starts spring 2027.
- [YouTube channel](https://www.youtube.com/@sameoldsamsara): Same Old Samsara, a season a year. Season 1 is 2026.
- [Season 1 · Episode 1: we bought land.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xSpspkCw9og) (41:24): 34 acres of goldenrod and woods in Central New York. How we found it, the rough perc test, and the first walk as owners.
- [Season 1 · Episode 2: our first month on 34 acres.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YDUcJU_dp78) (23:33): No tractor and no brush hog, just a scythe, a push mower and a lot of goldenrod. We cut a path to the old shed, move the RV onto the land and ride out the first thunderstorm.
- [Season 1 · Episode 3: peak fall. then the cold came.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SDIN5Jiadio) (25:51): Red maples, gold goldenrod, then frost and the first snow. Four RV tires changed on soft ground, two bear stories, one tree that had to come down, and a few 28 degree nights that made the call for us.
- [Season 1 · Episode 4: hunting for a lost well.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UhMJZrZttDI) (26:41): A neighbor says there's an old well somewhere on the land, so Chad builds a contraption out of a pipe and some wire and goes looking. We move the house site, find a giant sycamore leaf on an island in the river, and the trail cam catches its first raccoon.
- [Season 1 · Episode 5: we put 5 trail cams on our 34 acres.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ieGJnPSMPlM) (23:42): The trail cams finally go up, one that sends photos to a phone and four that save to SD cards. The first check catches exactly two animals, us. Before that the RV scrapes on our own driveway, and after it come an air pruning bed, bear scratches in the woods and a mushroom hunt that finds almost nothing.

## Make
- [Make](https://sameoldsamsara.xyz/make/): everything we make in one place, beading patterns and recipes so far.

## Beading patterns
PDF patterns, all free (leave an email to download). Full library: https://sameoldsamsara.xyz/patterns/

- [pumpkin](https://sameoldsamsara.xyz/patterns/pumpkin/): free brick stitch pattern. A little round pumpkin with a curly stem. Quick, cute and free.
- [flying saucer](https://sameoldsamsara.xyz/patterns/flying-saucer/): free brick stitch pattern. A gray saucer beaming down. Yellow beam or rainbow beam, one PDF each.
- [jellyfish (3 sizes)](https://sameoldsamsara.xyz/patterns/jellyfish/): free brick stitch pattern. A round jellyfish bell with wavy fringe. Small, medium and large, two colorways, all in one PDF.
- [magic rainbow mushroom](https://sameoldsamsara.xyz/patterns/magic-rainbow-mushroom/): free brick stitch pattern. A rainbow cap on a little beige stem. Bright and a little trippy.
- [om symbol](https://sameoldsamsara.xyz/patterns/om-symbol/): free brick stitch pattern. A black Om on a soft beige ground. Simple and steady.
- [rainbow parrot](https://sameoldsamsara.xyz/patterns/rainbow-parrot/): free brick stitch pattern. A scarlet macaw in nine colors: red, gold, green, cornflower and a long navy tail on a perch.
- [silly goose](https://sameoldsamsara.xyz/patterns/silly-goose/): free brick stitch pattern. A white goose with an orange beak and feet, framed in black. For the silly geese.
- [squid (wavy fringe)](https://sameoldsamsara.xyz/patterns/squid-wavy-fringe/): free brick stitch pattern. A little plum squid with big eyes and long wavy fringe tentacles. The wave comes from the thread, and the pattern shows you how.
- [triceratops](https://sameoldsamsara.xyz/patterns/triceratops/): free brick stitch pattern. A little green triceratops with terra cotta horns and a spotted back.
- [aliens](https://sameoldsamsara.xyz/patterns/aliens-loom/): free loom pattern. A row of little alien heads for the bead loom. Green or rainbow.
- [dna double helix](https://sameoldsamsara.xyz/patterns/dna-double-helix/): free loom pattern. A rainbow double helix bracelet for the bead loom.
- [rainbow diamonds](https://sameoldsamsara.xyz/patterns/rainbow-diamonds/): free loom pattern. A rainbow diamond band for the bead loom. Free.
- [rainbow snake](https://sameoldsamsara.xyz/patterns/rainbow-snake/): free loom pattern. A rainbow snake wave for the bead loom.
- [rainbow spirals](https://sameoldsamsara.xyz/patterns/rainbow-spirals/): free loom pattern. Rainbow spirals for the bead loom. Bold and hypnotic.
- [jack o' lantern](https://sameoldsamsara.xyz/patterns/jack-o-lantern/): free brick stitch pattern. A grinning jack o' lantern.
- [jack o' lantern in a witch hat](https://sameoldsamsara.xyz/patterns/jack-o-lantern-witch-hat/): free brick stitch pattern. A jack o' lantern wearing a witch hat. Both Halloween classics at once.
- [spooky ghost](https://sameoldsamsara.xyz/patterns/spooky-ghost/): free brick stitch pattern. A wavy little ghost mid float.
- [spooky season](https://sameoldsamsara.xyz/patterns/spooky-season/): free brick stitch pattern. A spooky season set for October.
- [witch hat + wizard hat](https://sameoldsamsara.xyz/patterns/witch-and-wizard-hats/): free brick stitch pattern. Two pointy hats, one listing. A witch hat and a starry wizard hat.
- [christmas tree](https://sameoldsamsara.xyz/patterns/christmas-tree/): free brick stitch pattern. A three tier pine with a gold star and a few lights. One piece worked up from the widest row, so it's a good first pattern. Free for the holidays.

## Tools
- [The field guide](https://sameoldsamsara.xyz/land/#field-guide): the animals, plants and fungi found on the land so far, as a small guessing game.
- [The bead lab](https://sameoldsamsara.xyz/bead-lab/): free in-browser brick stitch designer. Toho 11/0 colors, mirror mode, exports a word chart.

## Recipes
- [Maple Pecan Sweet Potato Mash](https://sameoldsamsara.xyz/recipes/maple-pecan-sweet-potato-mash/): Creamy sweet potatoes baked under toasted pecans and a drizzle of maple syrup.
